text:
Ana (Partnerships): FYI vendor onboarding for SFX Dynamics is blocked — marketplace portal refuses the NDA because the signer used a corporate stamp (PDF) instead of an embedded e-signature. procurement won't issue PO until portal shows counter-signed NDA.
James (Deal Desk): Ugh. procurement needs portal state to be "signed" yes? what error do we see in UI?
Ana (Partnerships): Screenshot says: `Signature type not supported: raster_stamp` and the upload form drops to 'Needs manual review'. Portal link: https://portal.redwood.example/vendors/SFXD/onboarding
James (Deal Desk): Procurement says they can't generate PO without portal state = signed. Finance hold until legal confirms.
Sara (Legal): I can accept a manually countersigned PDF as interim evidence, but we need an audit trail. If we get a notarized/stamped PDF plus sender verification, legal will clear for provisional PO. No unilateral exceptions without docs.
Mike (Finance): On our side, we can issue a provisional PO with "Pending portal verification" note and cap the spend to first month only. Need legal sign-off.
Eli (Eng): We could flip an admin toggle to accept "manual_signed_uploads" for specific vendor IDs for 24h while internal team confirms. It's a quick feature flag flip in the admin UI. Would need product approval and an internal ticket for auditability.
Ana (Partnerships): @Sara can you confirm you accept scanned countersigned NDA (PDF) + email verification as sufficient for Finance to issue provisional PO? Also looping @Eli — can you outline risk/rollback for the flag?
Sara (Legal): I can accept scanned countersigned NDA + email header + sender's corporate domain verification. We need: 1) PDF stored in records, 2) confirmation email saved, 3) brief entry in contract log referencing ticket id. I approve this path.
Eli (Eng): Risk: small — manual uploads bypass signature-type validation; must be limited to vendor-specific flag; rollback easy (flip flag off). I'll open internal ticket INF-7892 and tag ops for logging. ETA to enable flag: ~2h after ticket triage.
portal-bot: Ticket created INF-7892 by Eli (Eng) — https://internal.redwood.example/tickets/INF-7892
James (Deal Desk): OK action plan: 1) Ana upload scanned countersigned NDA to vendor record, 2) Sara posts legal confirmation in ticket, 3) Eli enable flag INF-7892, 4) Mike issues provisional PO with cap. Who owns uploading docs?
Ana (Partnerships): I'll upload scanned file to the vendor portal now and paste the link here.
Ana (Partnerships): Uploaded: https://portal.redwood.example/storage/sfxd/nda_countersigned_2026-03-21.pdf
Sara (Legal): Confirmed I reviewed the PDF and email headers. Legal sign-off posted to ticket INF-7892: "Legal accepts scanned countersigned NDA for provisional PO issuance. Records required saved."
portal-bot: INF-7892 updated: Legal approval attached.
Eli (Eng): Enabled flag for vendor SFXD: `accept_manual_signed_uploads=true` — changeset: ops-release-2026-03-21-flag1. Rolling back is `false`. Logged in INF-7892.
Mike (Finance): Generating provisional PO #PO-100834 with note: "Provisional — contingent on portal verification; cap $15,000 first month". Will not auto-pay until verification window closes.
James (Deal Desk): Sending PO to vendor now, cc procurement. Can we mark pipeline as "onboarded-provisional" so sales doesn't accidentally recognize revenue?
Eli (Eng): Added tag `onboarded_provisional` to vendor record via admin API.
Ana (Partnerships): Thanks all — next steps: Partnerships to confirm when portal shows native "signed" state and then we flip the flag off. Target: resolve full portal flow by EOD tomorrow.
Sara (Legal): I'll re-review once portal-native signature is present then clear for final PO.
Mike (Finance): Noted. Finance will convert provisional PO to final only after legal confirms native portal state.
James (Deal Desk): Marking this thread resolved for now. Closing actions: INF-7892 (eng flag), upload NDA link (done), PO-100834 (issued), legal approval (done). :white_check_mark:
Ana (Partnerships): Closing thread — will re-open if any regression. Thanks team.
